lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill region. Centroids are well-defined in the mid-flank area, exhibiting a lattice-like spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot centroids to form a regular grid pattern across the lateral flank, with anchor nodes most prominent at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper flank. They are defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition, with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a pronounced shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated toward the anterior base and central surface area of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, elongated darker object attached to the lower flank, posterior to the pectoral fin, consistent with a parasitic or commensal organism.
